# Third-party code

These files are copied unmodified so OpenCue loads nothing from a CDN at runtime.

| File | Library | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `peerjs.min.js` | [PeerJS](https://peerjs.com) — WebRTC peer-to-peer connections for the phone remote | 1.5.4 | MIT, see `PEERJS-LICENSE.txt` |
| `qrcode.js` | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) by Kazuhiko Arase — draws the pairing QR code | 1.4.4 | MIT (license header at the top of the file) |

Source: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/peerjs@1.5.4/dist/peerjs.min.js` and `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js`.
